answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon emits challenge words and every agent must weave them into a fresh task response. Precomputed templates fail because tomorrow's words like haven, signal, lantern are unpredictable, so fake identities cannot reuse canned answers. Each sybil account therefore needs real inference compute per epoch plus locked stake, and mismatched or duplicate answers slash that stake. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest agents pay one cheap response per epoch, pushing the sybil margin negative.
